 The 2026 midterms are underway.
 Hundreds of Congressional seats are on the line this November. Enjoy exclusive Press Pass benefits — like our new Inside the White House with Liz Landers newsletter and more — while helping make PBS News journalism possible.
 Join Press Pass
 Latest coverage
 See all election coverage 
 Nov 19
 Mississippi saw a spike in 'inactive' voters for the midterms. Democratic lawmakers want answers 
 By Camille Baker, Sophie Bates, Associated Press
 Lawmakers want an investigation and legislation to ensure that eligible voters are not mistakenly moved to inactive status, especially as the party tries to maintain its political momentum going into next year's race for governor.
 Continue reading 
 Nov 19
 Republican Rep. Nick Begich wins reelection for Alaska House seat 
 By Becky Bohrer, Associated Press
 His win Wednesday through the state's ranked vote tabulation process was a rare bright spot for Republicans, whose ranks in the House were decimated in the midterms.
 Continue reading 
 Nov 18
 Democrats flipped 9 U.S. Senate seats — the most in almost 70 years 
 By Robert Yoon, Associated Press
 Former Rep. Mary Peltola’s victory over Republican incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan in Alaska’s competitive U.S. Senate race has flipped a ninth Republican-held seat to the Democrats, giving Peltola’s party its biggest midterm gain in nearly 70 years.
 Continue reading 
 Nov 18
 Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate seat, beating Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan 
 By Becky Bohrer, Associated Press
 The Alaska race was the last U.S. Senate contest to be resolved in this year's midterm elections and gave Democrats a 56-44 majority after they flipped nine GOP-held seats to retake the chamber.
 Continue reading 
 Nov 15
 Trump's handpicked party chair faces a rebellion as midterm losses challenge president's grip on GOP 
 By Steve Peoples, Jill Colvin, Associated Press
 The emerging fight, which will shape the 2028 presidential nominating contest, represents a rare challenge to Trump's dominance, even after the party's worst midterm performance in a generation.
 Continue reading 
 Nov 14
 Democrats try out a strange new emotion at post-midterms What's Next conference: hope 
 By Nicholas Riccardi, Associated Press
 Democrats spent two days chewing over their future at the What's Next conference and trying to deal with the fact that it looks, for a moment at least, quite bright.
 Continue reading 
 Nov 14
 Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins becomes first Democrat since 1998 elected governor in Alaska 
 By Becky Bohrer, Associated Press
 His victory means Democrats will control the governor's office in 30 states, including several they flipped after years of Republican control in places such as Iowa, Georgia, Ohio and Texas.
 Continue reading 
 Nov 13
 GOP Rep. Lauren Boebert of Colorado loses U.S. House seat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher 
 By Nicholas Riccardi, Associated Press
 Democrat Eileen Laubacher defeated Rep. Lauren Boebert for a Colorado U.S. House seat on Friday, ousting a three-term Republican and staple of conservative media.
 Continue reading 
 Nov 12
 Watch 3:22 
 How Scott Colom won his longshot bid to flip Mississippi's Senate seat 
 By Liz Landers, Jonah Anderson
 In Mississippi, Democrat Scott Colom won his longshot bid to oust incumbent Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith. Colom’s victory is a stunning reversal in the deeply conservative state that hasn’t been represented by a Black senator since the Reconstruction era following…
 Continue watching 
 Nov 12
 Watch 11:39 
 Abdul El-Sayed on Democratic leadership, health care access and inspiring a new generation 
 By Amna Nawaz, Ali Schmitz
 The new Democratic senators are in Washington for orientation and are already facing tough questions about how they plan to govern. One is Abdul El-Sayed of Michigan, the first Muslim elected to the Senate. His win came after a hard-fought…
 Continue watching
